description: The dated steps of ONE sanctioning process from the regulator's own records: an ANEEL auto de infração (issued, received, appeal, decisions, closure), an ANS penalty case (1st and 2nd instance, payment, archiving) or an ANATEL PADO process (phases, dated when first observed). Returns the regulator, the source url, the company only when the record binds it by CNPJ to a tracked company, and each span's days next to that regulator's published base rate (median, quartiles, N; estimativa). Use for 'where is auto 0001/2019-AGEPAN-SFE and is it slow'. Needs the regulator's sector licensed (ANEEL energy, ANS health, ANATEL telecom). Deterministic: computed from official datasets, no model in the loop.

process.description: The process id: ANEEL auto number ('0001/2019-AGEPAN-SFE') or SEI process ('48500.026432/2025-01'), ANS demanda or processo ('33902.499206/2016-46'), or ANATEL PADO process number.

regulator.description: Optional. Restrict the lookup to one regulator.
